mechanism: Phenytoin induces CYP3A4 metabolism, reducing isotretinoin plasma concentrations and efficacy; isotretinoin may increase phenytoin levels through CYP2C9 inhibition, risking phenytoin toxicity.
action: Monitor phenytoin levels closely; consider alternative anticonvulsant if possible; if combination necessary, increase isotretinoin dose under dermatologic supervision and assess phenytoin toxicity signs.
